node.title: Incidence-only route fence for the rate-half type-2 FR bound
node.statement: At the power-of-two scale m=64 there is an explicit set system with N=16m, rho=4m-1, T=rho+2, a=7m-1, exact saturation deficit sum_x(m-d_x)=1, every pair union at least a, and every individual outside-W spend at least m+2, but max_gamma |S_gamma intersect W|=3m-3>2m. Thus the incidence/cardinality inputs used by NEWCAP do not imply the proposed FR max-intersection bound. The witness is not a realizable Hankel-pencil counterexample; any positive FR theorem must use additional GRS/apolar algebra.
